phase: 9A — Play Lobby, activation clarity, multi-position placement

results.name: the lobby exists as its own component
the lobby reads the registry's two tiers
each card carries a glyph, a name, one sentence, a status badge and ONE action
a card's action is a real link when it has an address
the recommended flag is a word, not only a colour
the lobby never starts a game
the lobby only READS a remembered run
the EraClash Mk1 logo is the lobby's mark
no competitor asset, name or wording is referenced
no simulation statistics, roster intelligence or comparison tables on a card
the primary action is EraClash gold, not an orange system
touch targets are at least 44px
three columns, then two, then one
focus is visible on a card's action
reduced motion is respected
`/` and /play render the lobby; the Time Arena keeps /play/chaos
the logo goes to the lobby without touching the run
a game-opening link bypasses the lobby
the lobby fits the access gate and the SPA rewrites
the Continue card shows stage, era status, last activity, both identities, Continue and Abandon
